capabilities: Set a pixel width on PDF embeds via wiki-link syntax like ![[file.pdf|500]]
Render resized PDFs in Reading view and Live Preview
Clamp widths below 100px to a minimum rendered width and ignore invalid values
Keep embeds responsive within the available note width
disambiguation: Does not resize or modify PDF files themselves; it only changes how embedded PDFs are rendered in notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the plugins folder); release history is in a separate CHANGELOG.md.
problem: Obsidian's embed width syntax works for images but not for PDF embeds, which always render at the default size.
summary: Renders embedded PDFs at a pixel width written in the wiki-link, using the same width syntax Obsidian supports for image embeds.
